entries.en: The discussion of amino-acidemia continued after the lecture had ended.
entries.zh: 讲座结束后，关于氨基酸血的讨论仍在继续。

entries.en: The clinician omitted the patient's name from the amino-aciduria case summary.
entries.zh: 临床医生在氨基酸尿病例摘要中省去了患者的姓名。

entries.en: The amino-acylase assay had to be repeated after a recording error.
entries.zh: 由于记录出错，氨基酰化酶测定不得不重做。

entries.en: A faint spot on the chart was attributed to an amino-aldohexose.
entries.zh: 图表上的一个模糊斑点被认为来自一种氨基己醛糖。

entries.en: The old inventory listed amino-arsenoxide separately from the other archived research materials.
entries.zh: 旧清单把氧化氨基胂与其他存档研究材料分开列出。

entries.en: The old dye study included a hand-drawn structure of amino-azo-benzene.
entries.zh: 那项较早的染料研究中附有一幅手绘的氨基偶氮苯结构图。

entries.en: The analyst compared the amino-azotoluene results with last week's control measurements.
entries.zh: 分析员把氨基偶氮甲苯的结果与上周的对照测量结果作了比较。

entries.en: The researchers disagreed about the interpretation of the amino-azotoluol data.
entries.zh: 研究人员对氨基偶氮甲苯数据的解读存在分歧。

entries.meaningZh: 氨合物〔此处指氨配位的配合物〕
entries.en: A drawing of the amino-complex was missing from the revised comparison chart.
entries.zh: 修订后的对比图表中缺少了那幅氨合物的示意图。

entries.en: The report listed the amino-ethanol concentration without identifying the sample.
entries.zh: 报告列出了氨基乙醇的浓度，却没有注明样品的身份。

entries.en: An arrow pointed to the amino-group at the edge of the diagram.
entries.zh: 一个箭头指向示意图边缘的那个氨基。

entries.en: The graph compared amino-nitrogen measurements from several samples.
entries.zh: 这张图比较了几个样品的氨基氮测量结果。

entries.en: The analyst noticed that the amino-oxamide sample number differed between the two records.
entries.zh: 分析员注意到，两份记录中的氨基草酰肼样品编号不一致。

entries.en: We asked for a clearer image of the amino-uracil structure.
entries.zh: 我们要求提供一幅更清晰的氨基尿嘧啶结构图。

entries.en: The aminoacetal sample number was illegible on the damaged worksheet.
entries.zh: 受损记录表上的氨基乙缩醛样品编号已经无法辨认。

entries.en: Only the first chromatogram in the folder belonged to the aminoacetonitrile sample.
entries.zh: 文件夹里只有第一张色谱图对应的是氨基乙腈样品。

entries.en: The technician checked which aminoacetophenone isomer the archived sample contained.
entries.zh: 技术员核查了存档样品中含的是哪一种氨基苯乙酮异构体。

entries.en: The family requested a copy of the aminoacidopathy consultation report.
entries.zh: 家属要求获取一份氨基酸病会诊报告的副本。

entries.en: The aminoacyl group was drawn in blue to distinguish it from the rest.
entries.zh: 氨酰基被画成蓝色，以便与其余部分区分。

entries.en: The student enlarged the aminoacyl-tRNA diagram so the attachment could be seen.
entries.zh: 学生放大了氨酰转移RNA示意图，以便看清连接处。

entries.en: An aminoadipaldehyde result was entered in the wrong column of the worksheet.
entries.zh: 一项氨基己二酸半醛结果被填进了记录表的错误列中。

entries.en: The two drawings showed different arrangements of the aminobenzaldoxime substituents.
entries.zh: 两幅图展示了氨基苯甲醛肟取代基的不同排列。

entries.en: The chemist compared the archived aminobenzene spectra on a larger screen.
entries.zh: 化学家在一块更大的屏幕上对比了存档的氨基苯谱图。

entries.meaningZh: 氨基苯甲酸的〔用于aminobenzoic acid〕
entries.en: The aminobenzoic acid sample had been entered twice in the inventory.
entries.zh: 那份氨基苯甲酸样品在清单中被登记了两次。

entries.en: She moved the aminobenzophenone plots into an appendix to shorten the paper.
entries.zh: 她把氨基二苯甲酮图表移到了附录中，以缩短论文篇幅。

entries.en: The aminobenzothiazole sketch on the blackboard needed one more correction.
entries.zh: 黑板上的氨基苯并噻唑草图还需要修改一处。

entries.en: The laboratory retained the aminobiphenyl spectra after the study had closed.
entries.zh: 研究结束后，实验室保留了氨基联苯的谱图。

entries.en: The table did not specify which aminodimethylbenzene isomer had been analysed.
entries.zh: 表格没有注明分析的是哪一种二甲苯胺异构体。

entries.en: An extra page of aminoethane measurements had slipped behind the cover.
entries.zh: 一页额外的乙胺测量记录滑到了封皮后面。

entries.en: The team could not match the aminoethylacetanilide results to a sample number.
entries.zh: 研究组无法把乙酰氨苯基乙胺的结果与样品编号对应起来。

entries.en: The archivist found the missing aminoglutethimide study in a box of unpublished papers.
entries.zh: 档案管理员在一箱未发表的论文中找到了那份不见了的氨鲁米特研究。

entries.en: Please keep the aminoguanidine results separate from the preliminary calculations.
entries.zh: 请把氨基胍的结果与初步计算分开存放。

entries.en: The aminohexane isomer was not identified in the preliminary report.
entries.zh: 初步报告中没有注明是哪一种氨基己烷异构体。

entries.en: Our notes on aminohydrolase activity were scattered across three notebooks.
entries.zh: 我们关于氨基水解酶活性的笔记分散在三本笔记本中。

entries.meaningZh: 蛋白质水解物〔旧制剂 aminokrovin〕
entries.en: The historical exhibition paired the aminokrovin packaging with a letter from the same collection.
entries.zh: 历史展览把那件蛋白质水解制剂包装与同一藏品系列的一封信放在一起展示。

entries.en: The table compared the aminolipin fractions before and after storage.
entries.zh: 表格比较了存储前后的氨基脂组分。

entries.en: They disagreed over how to present aminomercuration in the reaction scheme.
entries.zh: 他们对如何在反应示意图中展示氨汞化存在分歧。

entries.en: The cataloguing error placed the aminomethanamidine records under the wrong sample number.
entries.zh: 编目错误使胍的记录被归在了错误的样品编号下。

entries.en: The molecular model of the aminonucleoside had lost one of its connecting rods.
entries.zh: 那个氨基核苷分子模型少了一根连接杆。

entries.en: We found the original aminooxamide measurements on the reverse of the worksheet.
entries.zh: 我们在记录表的背面找到了原始氨基草酰肼测量记录。

entries.en: A torn page interrupted the discussion of aminopentamide in the old volume.
entries.zh: 那本旧书有一页破损，使有关胺戊酰胺的论述不连贯。

entries.en: We postponed the aminopeptidase assay until the replacement equipment arrived.
entries.zh: 我们推迟了氨基肽酶测定，直到替换设备送来。

entries.en: The conservator compared two damaged handles made from aminoplastics.
entries.zh: 文物修复师对比了两个用氨基塑料制成的受损把手。

entries.en: Her presentation on aminopolypeptidase ended with questions about the experimental controls.
entries.zh: 她关于氨基多肽酶的报告以有关实验对照的提问结束。

entries.en: The publisher requested permission to reproduce the original aminopromazine study.
entries.zh: 出版方申请获准重印那份原始氨丙嗪研究。

entries.en: The aminopropionitrile samples were identified by numbers, not by researchers' names.
entries.zh: 氨基丙腈样品以数字编号标识，而不是用研究人员的姓名。

entries.en: Our team reviewed the aminopropylon data together before deciding what to publish.
entries.zh: 研究组一起审阅了氨丙吡酮数据，然后才决定发表哪些内容。

entries.en: The laboratory's aminoprotease measurements were recorded in a notebook with a green cover.
entries.zh: 实验室的氨基蛋白酶测量记录写在一本绿色封皮的笔记本中。

entries.en: Our project folder contains scans of several aminopterin studies.
entries.zh: 我们的项目文件夹里存着几项氨喋呤研究的扫描件。

entries.en: The aminoquincarbamide report included a fold-out chart too large for the scanner.
entries.zh: 双氨甲喹脲报告附有一张折页图表，尺寸太大，放不进扫描仪。

entries.en: The aminoquinol measurements differed between the duplicate worksheets.
entries.zh: 两份重复记录表中的阿米诺喹测量结果不一致。

entries.en: The journalist requested the archived correspondence about aminorex.
entries.zh: 那位记者申请查阅有关阿米雷司的存档信件。

entries.en: The figure did not identify which aminosalicylate the comparison involved.
entries.zh: 图中没有注明对比涉及的是哪一种氨基水杨酸盐。

entries.en: We were given an anonymised case history of aminosis to discuss.
entries.zh: 我们拿到了一份匿名化的氨基酸过多症病史，供讨论使用。

entries.meaningZh: 血纤维蛋白水解产物〔旧制剂名 aminosol〕
entries.en: The photograph of the old Aminosol package was too blurred for the exhibition catalogue.
entries.zh: 那张血纤维蛋白水解制剂旧包装的照片太模糊，无法用于展览图录。

entries.en: The archive photograph showed an aminostiburea package with a badly damaged corner.
entries.zh: 那张存档照片显示，一个脲锑胺苷包装的角部严重损坏。

entries.en: The notes on aminosuria contained no identifying details about the patient.
entries.zh: 有关胺尿的记录中没有可识别患者身份的细节。

entries.en: An enlarged drawing made the aminothiouracil structure easier to follow during the seminar.
entries.zh: 放大的图让研讨会上的听众更容易看懂氨基硫脲嘧啶结构。

entries.en: The aminotoluene chart had been photocopied too faintly to show the smaller peaks.
entries.zh: 氨基甲苯图表复印得太浅，较小的峰看不出来。

entries.en: The environmental review included several pages of aminotriazole monitoring records.
entries.zh: 环境审查材料中包含数页氨基三唑监测记录。

entries.en: A missing date prevented us from matching the aminoxylene sample to the correct run.
entries.zh: 由于缺少日期，我们无法把二甲苯胺样品与正确的测定批次对应起来。

entries.meaningZh: 二甲基琥珀酰肼〔别名 aminozide〕
entries.en: Two handwritten pages accompanied the archived aminozide analysis.
entries.zh: 那份存档的二甲基琥珀酰肼分析附有两页手写材料。

entries.en: The older account of aminuria was written without a table of results.
entries.zh: 那份较早的胺尿记述没有附结果表。

entries.meaningZh: 支链淀粉〔此处指蜡质玉米来源的支链淀粉〕
entries.en: The amioca sample was displayed beside the other starches in the teaching collection.
entries.zh: 教学标本系列中，那份蜡质玉米来源的支链淀粉样品与其他淀粉一同展出。

entries.en: The lecturer paused the discussion of amiosis to correct an error in the diagram.
entries.zh: 讲师暂停了有关不减数分裂的讨论，纠正图中的一处错误。

entries.en: She compared two faded photographs of the same amiphenazole package.
entries.zh: 她对比了同一个阿米苯唑包装的两张褪色照片。

entries.en: The archived Amiphos measurements were separated from the later survey results.
entries.zh: 存档的敌磷测量记录与后来的调查结果分开存放。

entries.en: A damaged binding made the older amisometradine report difficult to photocopy.
entries.zh: 那份较早的阿米美啶报告装订处损坏，很难复印。

entries.en: The illustrator left more space above Amitabha in the unfinished painting.
entries.zh: 插画师在那幅未完成的画中，为阿弥陀佛上方留出了更多空间。

entries.meaningZh: 阿米他〔异戊基乙基巴比土酸的旧别名〕
entries.en: The pharmacist's old amital inventory was preserved with the handwritten receipts.
entries.zh: 那位药剂师的旧阿米他清单与手写收据一同保存着。

entries.en: She requested a translation of the handwritten letter about amithiozone.
entries.zh: 她请求翻译那封有关硫醋腙的手写信。

entries.en: The museum kept the empty amiton container behind glass.
entries.zh: 博物馆把那个空的胺吸磷容器放在玻璃后面。

entries.en: The folder of amitraz monitoring results had been filed under the wrong year.
entries.zh: 存放虫螨脒监测结果的文件夹被归到了错误的年份下。

entries.en: The researcher compared the two amitriptylinoxide abstracts before requesting the full papers.
entries.zh: 研究人员先对比了两份氧阿米替林研究摘要，再申请获取全文。

entries.meaningZh: 阿米西群〔亦译阿米特林〕
entries.en: One amixetrine spectrum was printed on the reverse of an unrelated worksheet.
entries.zh: 一张阿米西群谱图印在了一份无关记录表的背面。

entries.en: The historical review devoted a short section to amixia alongside the earlier case reports.
entries.zh: 那篇历史综述在较早的病例报告之外，还用一小节讨论了交配不能。

entries.en: The old field notebook contained a faded photograph of an amizol container.
entries.zh: 旧田间笔记本中夹着一张杀草强容器的褪色照片。

entries.meaningZh: 氨化硝酸银液〔旧制剂 ammargenum〕
entries.en: The historian found an Ammargenum invoice inside the pharmacy's old account book.
entries.zh: 历史研究者在那家药房的旧账簿中找到了一张氨化硝酸银液发票。

entries.meaningZh: 氨基磺酸铵〔旧别名 Ammate〕
entries.en: The faded Ammate analysis sheet was attached to a letter from the same archive.
entries.zh: 那张褪色的氨基磺酸铵分析记录表附在一封来自同一档案的信后。

entries.en: The ammelide results were left out of the first draft by mistake.
entries.zh: 初稿中误漏了三聚氰酸一酰胺的结果。

entries.en: The analyst discovered two separate folders of ammeline spectra on the shared drive.
entries.zh: 分析员在共享盘中发现了两个分别存放三聚氰酸二酰胺谱图的文件夹。

entries.en: The botanist compared the pressed Ammi specimens under a magnifying glass.
entries.zh: 植物学家用放大镜对比了压制的阿密属植物标本。

entries.en: The student redrew the ammino-complex so its connections were easier to see.
entries.zh: 学生重新画了那个氨配合物，让其中的连接更容易看清。

entries.en: The curator asked for a sharper photograph of the old ammiolite specimen.
entries.zh: 馆员要求提供那件旧铜锑汞矿物标本的一张更清晰的照片。

entries.en: The medical historian examined a drawing of ammism in the old travel account.
entries.zh: 医学史研究者查看了那篇旧游记中的一幅沙浴疗法图画。

entries.en: The palaeontologist checked the specimens filed under Ammodiscacea before closing the drawer.
entries.zh: 古生物学家在关上抽屉前，核查了归在沙盘虫总科下的标本。

entries.en: The illustration of Ammodytoidei had been folded into the back of the reference book.
entries.zh: 那幅玉筋鱼亚目插图被折好夹在了参考书后面。

entries.en: The mythology lecture ended with a comparison of two drawings of Ammon.
entries.zh: 神话讲座以对比两幅阿蒙神的图画结束。

entries.en: The historian requested the old purchase records for ammonal.
entries.zh: 历史研究者申请查阅阿芒拿尔炸药的旧采购记录。

entries.en: The chemist left more space beneath the sketch of the ammonate.
entries.zh: 化学家在那幅氨合物示意图下方留出了更多空白。

entries.en: The case summary mentioned ammonemia but did not reproduce the laboratory report.
entries.zh: 病例摘要提到了氨血症，但没有附上化验报告。

entries.en: The museum displayed a sealed jar of ammoniacum beside the old balance.
entries.zh: 博物馆在那架旧天平旁陈列了一罐密封的氨草胶。

entries.en: The question about ammonialyase activity came near the end of the seminar.
entries.zh: 关于解氨酶活性的问题是在研讨会快结束时提出的。

entries.en: The ammoniameter in the old photograph was missing part of its scale.
entries.zh: 旧照片里的那台氨浓度计缺少了一部分刻度。

entries.en: The faded chart grouped the ammonic compounds in a separate column.
entries.zh: 那张褪色图表把含氨或铵的化合物归在了单独一列。

entries.en: The inventory listed ammonioformaldehyde beside a handwritten reference to an earlier batch.
entries.zh: 清单中乌洛托品一项旁边，有一条手写记录指向更早的批次。

entries.en: The chemist checked the archived ammonionitrometry results against the original notebook.
entries.zh: 化学家对照原始笔记本，核查了存档的氨氮测定结果。

entries.en: The ammonization diagrams were enlarged for a lecture in the larger hall.
entries.zh: 为了在较大的讲堂中讲课，氨化作用示意图被放大了。

entries.en: She arranged the fossils assigned to Ammonoidea in a shallow display tray.
entries.zh: 她把归入菊石亚纲的化石摆放在一个浅展示盘中。

entries.en: The manuscript's account of ammonolysis was missing from the copy sent to the editor.
entries.zh: 寄给编辑的那份稿件中缺少了有关氨解作用的论述。

entries.meaningZh: 以氨为主要含氮排泄物的
entries.en: The lecturer drew a separate diagram for the ammonotelic animals in the comparison.
entries.zh: 讲师为比较中那些以氨为主要含氮排泄物的动物另画了一幅图。

entries.en: Two students compared their diagrams of ammonotelism after the lecture.
entries.zh: 讲座结束后，两名学生对比了各自的排氨代谢示意图。

entries.en: The storekeeper found an old ammophos invoice among the farm's receipts.
entries.zh: 仓库管理员在农场的收据中找到了一张安福粉旧发票。
